notes.title: 1.1 Fix
notes.content: Thank you to everyone who has sent feedback to help improve Sphoxie, I have redone the controls and it should be much easier to control the little dude with more precision and no more jumpyness/jolts. Thanks for playing and I hope you contine enjoying Sphoxie!

notes.title: Sphoxie is Live!
notes.content:
Finally after all these years, moving from the UDK to the Unreal Engine 4, redoing the entire control systems and trying to improve it in every way possible Sphoxie has made it to the PC where it can really shine!

I hope you enjoy it!
